purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for five registered catalog entries that had no dedicated individual application/result record in latest.json and were not yet represented as standalone entries in prior master-audit evidence. Research only; no affiliate application, partner account, legal acceptance, or duplicate queue UUID is created.

entries.commission: Up to 22% lifetime recurring commission on referred paying customers
entries.payout_terms: Partner materials state earnings are available on request after reaching $50; Partner app is used for tracking and withdrawals, with affiliate payout materials referencing PayPal.
entries.eligibility: Current official program is aimed at content creators, influencers, PPC marketers, review sites, bloggers and SaaS reviewers.
entries.shared_program_dedupe: Text App, LiveChat, ChatBot and HelpDesk are all monetized through the same Text Partner Program account. A later application queue must create/reuse only one Text partner account/application and must not submit four separate partner enrollments.
entries.legal_consent_note: Current Text Partner Program Terms state that registering for the program constitutes agreement to binding Partner Program Terms and Privacy Policy. No registration or acceptance was performed in this audit pass.
entries.evidence_summary: Text's current official affiliate page explicitly lists Text App as one of the products affiliates can promote and confirms up to 22% lifetime recurring commission, a 120-day cookie, free membership, and the shared Text Partner Program structure.

entries.commission: 30% recurring commission on all referred-customer payments for as long as the customer remains subscribed

entries.commission: Base 30% of monthly subscription revenue plus 10% of credit purchases; tiers increase to 35%/15% at 250-499 active referred users and 40%/20% at 500+
entries.payout_terms: Monthly via PayPal or bank transfer, paid within 14 days after the end of each month.
entries.eligibility: Official page identifies dropshipping experts, community owners, ecommerce influencers, marketing agencies and SaaS reviewers as ideal partners.

entries.evidence_summary: Catalister's current official affiliate page confirms an active recurring program with 30%-40% subscription commissions plus 10%-20% on credits, monthly PayPal/bank payouts, and a live affiliate portal. Cookie duration and any payout threshold are not asserted because the public official material retrieved did not state them.
